page.title: 比較級で変化と比例を描く

analysis.summaryJa: 比較級を単独の差から、時間とともに進む変化や二つの量が連動する比例へ広げる。than＋節に省略された程度の穴、everによる全経験との比較、「比較級 and 比較級」の継続変化、「the 比較級, the 比較級」の比例、理由を受けるall the比較級を扱う。
grammarPoints: than＋節では比較された程度・目的語が文脈上省略される
比較級＋than everで過去のどの時点より高い程度を表す
比較級 and 比較級で継続的な変化を表す
more型はmore and more＋形容詞・副詞にする
the 比較級, the 比較級で二つの変化の比例を表す
all the 比較級＋理由で「その分だけ」を表す
visualEvidence: 一つの緑線がstrongerを重ねながら上昇する単独変化のグラフ
練習量と易しさの赤青二線が連動して上がる比例グラフ
than＋文の穴、比較級＋ever、比較級and比較級、the比較級the比較級の4ルート
理由＋all the比較級＝その分だけ、という上部の小タグ
commonTraps: than節に不要な代名詞を重ねる
more型をmore useful and more usefulだけに固定して語順を崩す
the moreのtheを冠詞と誤解して省く
比例構文の二節の語順を通常文のままにする
everを最上級だけの語だと思う

questions.prompt: The installation took longer ------- the project manager had estimated.
questions.translationJa: 設置作業はプロジェクト管理者が見積もったより長くかかりました。
questions.explanationJa: than節ではestimatedの後ろに「かかる時間」の程度の穴が理解されます。

questions.prompt: After the redesign, the mobile app is easier to navigate than -------.
questions.translationJa: 再設計後、モバイルアプリはこれまでになく操作しやすくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: than everは過去のどの時点よりも高い程度を表します。

questions.prompt: As the holiday approached, the hotel became busier and -------.
questions.translationJa: 祝日が近づくにつれ、ホテルはますます混雑しました。
questions.explanationJa: -er型は同じ比較級をandで反復して継続変化を示します。
questions.focus: 比較級 and 比較級

questions.prompt: The updated checkout process is becoming more and more -------.
questions.translationJa: 更新された会計手続きはますます効率的になっています。
questions.explanationJa: more型はmore and more efficientの語順にします。

questions.prompt: The more detailed the schedule is, the ------- it is to coordinate the teams.
questions.translationJa: 日程が詳しければ詳しいほど、チームの調整が容易になります。
questions.explanationJa: the more ..., the easier ...で二つの程度の連動を表します。

questions.prompt: The longer customers wait, the ------- likely they are to return.
questions.translationJa: 顧客が長く待つほど、再来店する可能性は低くなります。
questions.explanationJa: 一方が増えるほど他方が減る比例もthe longer, the less likelyで表せます。

questions.prompt: The unexpected bonus made the successful quarter all the ------- satisfying.
questions.translationJa: 予想外の賞与のおかげで、成功した四半期がその分いっそう満足のいくものになりました。
questions.explanationJa: 理由が満足度をその分高めるall the more satisfyingが適切です。

questions.prompt: Traffic grew heavier and ------- as the conference opening time neared.
questions.translationJa: 会議の開始時刻が近づくにつれ、交通量はますます多くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: heavier and heavierが連続的な変化を表します。

questions.prompt: The faster the printer operates, the ------- frequently the paper tray needs refilling.
questions.translationJa: プリンターの動作が速いほど、給紙トレーを補充する頻度が高くなります。
questions.explanationJa: the fasterとthe more frequentlyが速度と頻度の比例を示します。

questions.prompt: This year’s customer rating is higher than it has ------- been.
questions.translationJa: 今年の顧客評価はこれまでで最も高い水準です。
questions.explanationJa: has ever beenで全期間の経験を含め、higher thanと結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing a result with an expectation.

choices.A: The repair was more expensive that we expected.
choices.B: The repair was more expensive than we expected.
choices.C: The repair was most expensive than we expected it.
choices.D: The repair was more expensive to we expected.

questions.translationJa: 修理は私たちの予想より高額でした。
questions.explanationJa: than節のexpectedの後ろには費用程度の穴が理解され、余分なitは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an all-time improvement.

choices.A: Our response time is shortest than ever.
choices.B: Our response time is shorter as ever.
choices.C: Our response time is more short than never.
choices.D: Our response time is shorter than ever.

questions.translationJa: 当社の応答時間はこれまでになく短くなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級shorter＋than everで過去全体を基準にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing continuous growth.

choices.A: Online orders increased faster and faster throughout the week.
choices.B: Online orders increased fastest and faster throughout the week.
choices.C: Online orders increased more fast and more fast throughout the week.
choices.D: Online orders increased faster and fastest throughout the week.

questions.translationJa: オンライン注文は週を通してますます速いペースで増えました。
questions.explanationJa: faster and fasterが変化の進行を示します。
questions.focus: 比較級 and 比較級

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing growing complexity.

choices.A: The approval process became more complicated and more.
choices.B: The approval process became most and most complicated.
choices.C: The approval process became more and more complicated.
choices.D: The approval process became more and complicated more.

questions.translationJa: 承認手続きはますます複雑になりました。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞はmore and more complicatedとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing linked change.

choices.A: Sooner we receive the parts, sooner production can resume.
choices.B: The sooner we receive the parts, production can resume the sooner.
choices.C: The soonest we receive the parts, the sooner production can resume.
choices.D: The sooner we receive the parts, the sooner production can resume.

questions.translationJa: 部品を早く受け取れば受け取るほど、生産を早く再開できます。
questions.explanationJa: 両節をthe＋比較級で始める比例構文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence linking quantity and accuracy.

choices.A: The most entries you check, the accurate the list becomes.
choices.B: The more entries you check, the more accurate the list becomes.
choices.C: More entries you check, more accurate becomes the list.
choices.D: The more entries you check, the list becomes more accurate.

questions.translationJa: 確認する項目が多いほど、一覧は正確になります。
questions.explanationJa: 後半もthe more accurateを前に出して比例を作ります。
questions.focus: the more＋名詞, the more＋形容詞

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a reason to intensify a comparison.

choices.A: The free upgrade made the offer all more appealing.
choices.B: The free upgrade made the offer all the most appealing.
choices.C: The free upgrade made the offer all the more appealing.
choices.D: The free upgrade made the offer the all more appealing.

questions.translationJa: 無料アップグレードによって、その提案はその分いっそう魅力的になりました。
questions.explanationJa: all the more appealingが理由による追加の魅力を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a worsening delay.

choices.A: As the storm continued, deliveries became later and later.
choices.B: As the storm continued, deliveries became latest and later.
choices.C: As the storm continued, deliveries became more late and more late.
choices.D: As the storm continued, deliveries became later and latest.

questions.translationJa: 嵐が続くにつれ、配送はますます遅くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: later and laterが継続的な悪化を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing current demand with all prior periods.

choices.A: Demand is strongest than it has ever been.
choices.B: Demand is stronger than it ever has been it.
choices.C: Demand is more strong as it has ever been.
choices.D: Demand is stronger than it has ever been.

questions.translationJa: 需要はこれまでになく強くなっています。
questions.explanationJa: stronger than it has ever beenが現在と過去全期間を比較します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing an inverse relationship.

choices.A: The few errors we make, the lesser time we spend on corrections.
choices.B: Fewer errors we make, less time we spend on corrections.
choices.C: The fewer errors we make, the less time we spend on corrections.
choices.D: The fewer errors we make, we spend the less time on corrections.

questions.translationJa: 誤りが少なければ少ないほど、修正に使う時間も少なくなります。
questions.explanationJa: the fewer＋複数名詞とthe less＋不可算名詞で減少同士の比例を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The launch took longer than we predicted."

choices.A: We predicted that the launch would be delayed forever.
choices.B: The launch ended sooner than predicted.
choices.C: No prediction was made about the launch.
choices.D: Our prediction underestimated the launch time.

questions.translationJa: 私たちの予測は発売作業の所要時間を短く見積もっていました。
questions.explanationJa: 実際が予測よりlongerなら、予測は時間を過小評価していたことになります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The office is quieter than ever."

choices.A: The office used to be equally quiet.
choices.B: The office has never been this quiet before.
choices.C: The office will become noisy soon.
choices.D: This is the quietest office in the building.

questions.translationJa: オフィスがこれほど静かだったことは以前にありません。
questions.explanationJa: quieter than everは過去のどの時点より静かという意味です。
questions.focus: 比較級＋than everの言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The queue grew longer and longer."

choices.B: The queue was the longest of three.
choices.C: The queue kept increasing in length.
choices.D: The queue remained the same length.

questions.translationJa: 列は長さを増し続けました。
questions.explanationJa: 比較級の反復は変化が連続して進んだことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The software is becoming more and more reliable."

choices.A: The software’s reliability continues to improve.
choices.B: The software has reached the highest possible reliability.
choices.C: The software becomes reliable only when updated twice.
choices.D: The software is less reliable with every update.

questions.translationJa: ソフトウェアの信頼性は向上し続けています。
questions.explanationJa: more and more reliableは程度が継続的に上がることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The earlier you book, the lower the fare will be."

choices.A: Every booking has the same fare.
choices.B: Booking sooner tends to reduce the fare.
choices.C: A lower fare causes people to book later.
choices.D: The fare falls only after the trip.

questions.translationJa: 早く予約するほど運賃が安くなる傾向があります。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの比較級が予約時期と運賃の連動を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The more we automate, the fewer errors occur."

choices.A: Automation and errors both increase together.
choices.B: Errors prevent the company from automating.
choices.C: Automation removes every possible error immediately.
choices.D: Increasing automation is associated with a decrease in errors.

questions.translationJa: 自動化が進むほど誤りが減る関係があります。
questions.explanationJa: the moreとthe fewerが一方の増加と他方の減少を結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The delay made an apology all the more necessary."

choices.A: Because of the delay, an apology became even more necessary.
choices.C: No apology was necessary after the delay.
choices.D: The delay and the apology were equally necessary.

questions.translationJa: 遅延があったため、謝罪がいっそう必要になりました。
questions.explanationJa: 理由を受けるall the moreはeven moreと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Costs became higher and higher."

choices.A: Costs reached one fixed high point immediately.
choices.B: Costs were higher than revenue only once.
choices.C: Costs continued to rise over time.

questions.translationJa: 費用は時間とともに上がり続けました。
questions.explanationJa: higher and higherは継続的上昇を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The less packaging we use, the less waste we create."

choices.D: Waste falls only when packaging increases.

questions.translationJa: 包装を減らすと、廃棄物も減ります。
questions.explanationJa: the less, the lessが二つの減少の連動を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Service is better than it has ever been."

choices.A: Service was equally good in every prior year.
choices.B: Service has reached its highest quality so far.
choices.D: The current service is worse than before.

questions.translationJa: サービスはこれまでで最高の品質に達しています。
questions.explanationJa: better than ... everは現在が過去全期間を上回ることを示します。
questions.focus: 比較級による過去最高

questions.prompt: The first budget was conservative, but material prices rose. The final cost was higher ------- we had anticipated.
questions.translationJa: 最初の予算は控えめでしたが、材料価格が上がりました。最終費用は私たちの予想より高くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: anticipatedの後ろに費用程度の穴を残すthan節です。

questions.prompt: The support team added live chat and weekend hours. Customer access is now easier than -------.
questions.translationJa: サポートチームはライブチャットと週末対応を追加しました。顧客はこれまでになく利用しやすくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在を過去全体と比べるthan everが自然です。

questions.prompt: Only a few people used the portal at first. After the tutorial, the number of users grew larger and -------.
questions.translationJa: 当初ポータルの利用者は少数でした。説明会後、利用者数はますます大きくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: larger and largerで連続的な増加を表します。
questions.focus: 比較級 and 比較級

questions.prompt: The team has added several approval stages. The procedure is becoming more and more -------.
questions.translationJa: チームはいくつもの承認段階を追加しました。手続きはますます時間がかかるものになっています。
questions.explanationJa: more型の複合形容詞はmore and more time-consumingです。

questions.prompt: Our discount depends on order size. The more units a customer buys, the ------- the price per unit becomes.
questions.translationJa: 割引率は注文量で決まります。顧客が多く買うほど、1個当たりの価格は安くなります。
questions.explanationJa: 購入量の増加と単価の低下をthe more, the lowerで結びます。

questions.prompt: We receive payment only after all documents are approved. The sooner you submit them, the ------- we can issue the invoice.
questions.translationJa: 支払いは全書類承認後に受け取ります。早く提出いただくほど、早く請求書を発行できます。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの時期が連動するthe sooner, the soonerです。

questions.prompt: The candidate speaks three languages and has relevant experience. Her strong references make her all the ------- suitable.
questions.translationJa: 候補者は3言語を話し、関連経験もあります。強い推薦状によって、その分いっそう適任です。
questions.explanationJa: 理由となる推薦状が適性を高めるall the more suitableを使います。

questions.prompt: At first, the printer jammed once a day. By Friday, it was jamming more and ------- frequently.
questions.translationJa: 当初プリンターの紙詰まりは1日1回でした。金曜日までには、ますます頻繁に詰まるようになりました。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞frequentlyの継続変化はmore and more frequentlyです。

questions.prompt: Every extra feature increases testing time. The more features we add, the ------- the release is likely to be.
questions.translationJa: 機能を追加するたびにテスト時間が増えます。機能が多いほど、発売は遅くなる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 機能数の増加と発売時期の遅延をthe more, the laterで示します。

questions.prompt: The hotel renovated every guest room and expanded its services. Its ratings are stronger than they have ------- been.
questions.translationJa: ホテルは全客室を改装し、サービスを拡充しました。評価はこれまでになく高くなっています。
questions.explanationJa: have ever beenで過去全期間を比較基準にします。
